text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, Feb 25 - Chittagong - 21 Vessels in port of which 4 containers, 3 food grain, 1 24 hours, 3 tankers, 5 general cargo, 1 cement, 3 fertiliser, 1 other vessel. 23 Vessels due by 4/3 of which 12 containers, 1 food grain, 3 survey vessels, 2 cement clinker, 2 24 hours, 2 tankers, 1 for scraping. 3-4 Days berthing delay expected for general cargo vessels.

INDIA, Feb 25 - Bombay - No labour problems. Four vessels loading at berth, 18 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage. 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 10 waiting to discharge, 1 bunkering, 2 under repair, 1 awaiting orders. Berthing delays, container vessels 1-2 days, bulkers 8-10 days, general cargo 2-3 days. Calcutta - Six vessels loading at berth, 10 discharging at berth, 2 vessels bunkering. 18 Vessels due (2 coking coal, 6 products tankers, 2 pulses, 5 containers, 1 petcoke, 2 logs).

Cochin - No labour problems. Four vessels discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchor to discharge, 1 bunkering, 1 tug and 1 small vessel at dry-dock and 1 bulker at shipyard jetty for repair/fitting. 1 Vessel awaiting orders, 8 due with up to 1 days delay expected. Chennai (Madras) - No labour problems. One vessel loading at berth, 9 discharging at berth, 7 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 dredger dry-docked. 28 Vessels due (5 general cargo, 6 coal, 12 containers, 1 fertiliser, 4 edible oil) with following delays, coal/coke 3-4 days, fertiliser/others 2-3 days, scrap 4-5 days, no delays for containers/iron ore.

Mormugao - No labour problems. Two vessels loading at berth, 1 loading at anchorage, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting to discharge, 2 under repair/dry-docked, 1 awaiting orders, 12 due with 4-5 days delay expected. Kandla - Five vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 1 discharging in stream, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 tankers, 23 vessels waiting. 19 Vessels due with 6-7 days delay expected.
